- Measure the answer for: a two-holder name with one holder disabled (address and bare), and a sole holder disabled (see the sibling card on disabled sole holders).
- If the door admits a post that never runs, choose: refuse at the door (status and code to decide with a Clause-② answer), or keep the admit and log it loudly. Analyse the options on the four axes.
